title: Sunday · the flag down
logline: The mailbox before Christmas, flag down, in three tiers: morning, noon, dusk. Nothing comes. The last tier draws the porch light coming on.

panels.composition: Tier 1: a roadside mailbox in morning fog, flag down.

image.prompt: a roadside mailbox in morning fog with its flag down, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Morning

panels.composition: Tier 2: the same mailbox at noon, a truck passing, flag down.

image.prompt: the same roadside mailbox at noon with a truck passing and its flag down, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Noon

panels.composition: Tier 3: the mailbox at dusk, flag down, a porch light on far back.

image.prompt: the same roadside mailbox at dusk with its flag down and a distant porch light coming on, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Dusk
